★ New Giant Boss Update - Spirit Lord’s Temple

A giant boss dungeon will be added to Atma’Ram: ‘Spirit Lord’s Temple’


Players cannot receive “Heroes Assemble” or “Hero in Battle” buff here.

Players cannot ride on a mount in this dungeon.

This dungeon is not be affected by Item Drop Rate stat, Drop Rate Medal, Event, or other sources that increase the drop rate.

There are no limits to entry and weekly rewards can be claimed up to 10 times.

Upon clearing the dungeon, a treasure box will appear. It will be opened once any party member interacts with F1.

Weekly Reward count will go down by 1 when the item drops from the Treasure Box.

Weekly Reward Count will reset Every Wednesday at 00:00.

Weekly Reward Count will only be recovered up to 10 regardless of what remaining count the player had.
[olist]
A new item that increases the Weekly Reward Count for Spirit Lord’s Temple: ‘Spirit Lord’s Temple Weekly Reward Count Restore Tag’ will be added.
[/olist]
This item can be used by right-clicking on the item in the inventory. This item cannot be used if the player has max Weekly Reward Count (10).

The fusion system will allow players to fuse the materials acquired from dismantling the accessories dropped from the ‘Spirit Lord’s Temple’.

Atma Aura cannot be traded or stored in shared bank. Players can acquire additional tradeable Atma Aura on a set chance.

 	The fusion system allows players to fuse the magic stones acquired from the Atma’Ram region.

 	Players can talk to the NPC Eris in Magmelia to fuse the magic stones.
 	Players can fuse 3 magic stones of equal ranks to attempt to acquire magic stones of higher rank.

 	Players can use Fuse All to automatically fuse all of the lowest rank items.

★ Giant Boss Difficulty Improvements

 	The entry player requirement will be changed to 1-6 players for all Giant Boss dungeons (Titan’s Grotto, Plegas’s Labyrinth, The Great Steel Wall)
 	The Giant Boss dungeons ‘Plegas’s Labyrinth’ and ‘Great Steel Wall’, which were previously only available during set entry times, will now be accessible at all times.
 	With ‘Plegas’s Labyrinth’ and ‘Great Steel Wall’ now accessible at all times, the number of free daily entries will be adjusted to 5.
 	The emblem that previously appeared during Giant Boss entry hours will be removed.
 	The difficulty for giant bosses will be reduced.

 	[Plegas's Labyrinth]

 	Phase 1

 	Reduced the HP of Plegas's Heart and increased damage received.
 	Increased the duration of Plegas's Heart fixating on a spot.
 	Phase 2

 	Increased the overload gauge gain of Regenerating Plegas.
 	Increased the overload duration of Regenerating Plegas.
 	Phase 3

 	Reduced the HP of Colossus Plegas.
 	The Ascending Current buff is applied at the start of battle.
 	Improved so that the central jump pads are permanently active.
 	Increased the duration of heart exposure after destroying the head.
 	Improved so that the ultimate is not forced to activate due to HP loss if the ultimate has been used at least once before.
 	[The Great Steel Wall]

 	Phase 1

 	Reduced the HP of Type-B Vargr and increased damage received.
 	Increased the groggy duration when Type-B Vargr’s legs are destroyed.
 	Phase 2

 	Reduced the HP of D Drake.
 	Reduced the HP of Battle Drones and Flight Drones.
 	Increased the overload gauge gain from turret attacks upon D Drake.
 	Increased the groggy duration of D Drake.
 	Phase 3

 	Reduced the HP of Type-L Lampery GT.
 	Reduced the HP of Type-L Lampery GT Hand - L/R.
 	Reduced the HP of Battle Drones and Flight Drones.
 	Reduced the HP of turrets.
 	Increased the inactive duration of Type-L Lampery GT Hand when only 1 of Type-L Lampery GT Hand - L/R is destroyed.
 	Improved so that the hand reactivates with HP reduced when Type-L Lampery GT Hand - L/R is reactivated.
 	Increased the midair duration of Type-L Lampery GT.
 	Increased the cooldown for the Charging Rod pattern.
★ Dungeon Difficulty Improvements

 	The difficulty of Shadow Earl's Castle will be reduced.

 	Changed so that the platforms are permanently active regardless of Gargoyle states.
 	Changed so that the Gargoyle light needed to progress to the next stage is permanently active.
 	Reduced Ran’s attack power.
 	Reduced the damage of Ran’s slash and charge attack.
 	Reduced the damage of Severed Severed Shadow Aren’s slash, charge, and sword aura attack.
 	Changed so that the pattern is canceled if a certain amount of damage is dealt when Ran or Aren is charging for an attack.
★ Master Class Portrait Update

 	Upon Master Class advancement, the portrait will automatically update to match the current class.

 	The 3rd Job portrait image will continue to be displayed as before in party UI, result screens, and similar displays.
★ Bank UI Improvements

 	Tooltips will now appear when hovering over membership tiers, providing information about bank access.
 	When clicking the character selection button, a UI list displaying the current character owned will appear. Players can now click or search nicknames to quickly and easily select a character.
 	The Shared Bank UI will be changed.

 	Tooltips will now appear when hovering over tiers, providing information about bank access.
 	The [Shared] tab can now be switched using the mouse wheel.

★ Item

★ Doom Aporia Raid Improvement

[Cornerstone of Prophecy]

 	Phase 1

 	Reduced the HP of Type-E Echidna and increased damage received.
 	Reduced the HP of the two types of Cores and increased damage received.
 	Changed the number of Hyperactive Skill needed to stop Type-E Echidna from charging from 3 to 2.
 	Reduced the damage needed to stop Type-E Echidna from charging.
 	Adjusted so that the HP Threshold Mechanic only occurs a total of 2 times.
 	Adjusted so that the HP Threshold Mechanic does not display charging patterns.
 	Core death happens faster.
 	Phase 2

 	Reduced the HP of Barkat and increased damage received.
 	Reduced the number of Discharge to activate the Elevator Console.
 	Death Zone pattern debuffs are more visible.
 	Fixating Dark Hands pattern targets 3 sets of 2 players → 3 sets of 1 player
 	Adjusted so that the HP Threshold Mechanic only occurs a total of 2 times.
[Nightmare Reset Room]

 	Phase 1

 	Reduced the HP of Bifron and increased damage received.
 	Increased the size of Illusory Area created with the Dungeon Function Key.
 	Adjusted so that the max number of souls for Match the Number of Souls Pattern is set to 4.
 	Adjusted so that the HP Threshold Mechanic only occurs a total of 3 times in Difficulty Stage 2 and 3.
 	Reduced the HP of Specter in Difficulty Stage 1.
 	Phase 2

 	Reduced the HP of Specter Swarm and increased damage received.
 	A marker will be placed so that players can tell which Illusory Zone they are in.
 	Adjusted so that the HP Threshold Mechanic only occurs a total of 3 times, 1 for each pattern.
 	Adjusted the timing of forced teleport after HP Threshold Mechanic has been completed.
 	Players can now press the dungeon function key to change the color of magic circles during the Find the Non-matching Furniture pattern in Illusory Zones. If all answers are marked with F1, the pattern will immediately be completed.
 	Improved so that each zone has 1 wrong furniture placement in the Find the Non-matching Furniture pattern in Illusory Zones.
[Queen’s Throne Hall]

 	Phase 1

 	Reduced the HP of Tarith and increased damage received.
 	Changed the speed of swapping sides when Tarith/Apollyon moves.
 	Changed so that Apollyon does not have collision.
 	Changed so that the player kidnapped by Apollyon at the start of Portal pattern will be immune to damage from other forms of damage for a moment.
 	Phase 2

 	Reduced the HP of Tarith and increased damage received.
 	Changed the speed of swapping sides when Tarith/Type-Q Steel Queen moves.
 	Changed so that Type-Q Steel Queen does not have collision.
 	Changed so that marks do not explode before shackling, and shackling happens at the same time for Tarith’s Mark pattern.
 	Changed so that Tarith’s Light Pillar Summon attack is removed at the start of HP Threshold Mechanic.
 	Changed so that deaths during the Sepiroth’s Spear HP Threshold Mechanic from both Tarith and Type-Q Queen no longer wipes the party, but causes no groggy.
 	Extended the delay on rifle firing for the Rifle pattern.
 	Changed so that targets of the rifle are smaller during the Rifle pattern.

[Wilting Tower: Flight]

 	Phase 1

 	Reduced the HP of Undead Dragon Jabberwock and increased damage received.
 	Reduced the number of interactions needed with the lightningrod to complete the Final Attack pattern.
 	Extended the time available to interact with the lightningrod during the Final Attack pattern.
 	Improved so that 2 failures in interacting with lightningrod are needed to wipe in the Final Attack pattern.
 	Improved so that players will receive mana bombs with the same ion for the Final Attack pattern.
 	Improved so that ions will be temporarily disabled after the transition in positions after the first Final Attack.
 	Extended the wait time after Energy Ball has been released.
 	Changed so that Energy Ball will be summoned from a fixed spot instead of dropping from the air.
 	Removed 2 types of ions from the Energy Ball pattern.
 	Changed so that all players alive will receive mana bomb in the Energy Charging pattern.
 	Changed so that all mana bombs during the Energy Charging pattern will be the opposite ion of the player’s ion.
 	Changed so that the party will only wipe if 2 or more lightningrods have not been interacted with in the Energy Charging pattern.
 	Undead Dragon Jabberwock will only go into groggy if all lightningrods have been interacted with.
 	Phase 2

 	Reduced the HP of Opinionated Barkat and increased damage received.
 	Death Zone pattern debuffs are more visible.
 	Reduced the number of Magic Circles in the Magic Circle pattern. Magic Circle placement will also be adjusted to reflect the changes.
 	Fixed so that upon entering the wrong number during the Prophecy pattern, only the player in the wrong slot will receive damage. Party will only wipe when 2 or more wrong entries have been made.
[Wilting Tower: Fall]

 	Reduced the HP of Energy Charging Device.
 	Reduced the HP of Echoes of Doom and increased damage received.
 	Changed that the drone will only deactivate when it is attacked 5 times.
 	Reduced the time for the drone to be activated again.
 	Changed so that character size is reduced during the Tornado pattern.
 	Changed so that the Energy Bubble from 5 stacks of debuff will not cause the orb to grow bigger during the Energy Discharge pattern.
 	Extended the wait time between the lasers in Scraps pattern and increased the hitbox of lasers.
 	Removed the number of symbols to match during Symbol pattern.
 	Reduced the number of lightning during Symbol pattern and increased the time between the lightning attacks.
 	Increased the groggy duration during berserk.

 	Improved so that 2 failures are needed to cause the party to wipe in the Difficulty Stage 3 Note Check pattern.
 	Players can now press the Dungeon Function Key to change the moving notes during the Sheet Play pattern.
 	Reduced the damage of note explosion during the Sheet Play pattern.
 	Increased the groggy duration for successful mechanic completion.
 	Extended the Note Activation Time for Skill Check pattern.
 	Improved so that the repeat mark only appears in the last pattern for Difficulty Stage 2 and Difficulty Stage 3.

 	Reduced the HP of Maestro and increased damage received.
 	Changed so that all dead players will be immediately resurrected before the HP Threshold Mechanic.
 	Reduced the number of notes needed to be played for Personal Performance pattern.
 	Changed so that 4 random players will be picked to perform for Ensemble pattern.
 	Reduced the number of notes needed to be played for Ensemble pattern.
 	Improved the visibility of Piano Performance pattern.
 	Reduced the number of notes needed to be played for Piano Performance pattern.

notes.title: Content Creator Program - July Update
notes.notes:
[img src="https://i.imgur.com/czINVlg.jpeg"]

 

Hello Adventurers!

We are excited to be back with another edition of our monthly GM blog series, which covers all of the latest content from the Content Creator Program.

As a reminder, anyone is able to apply to the program if they have interest in creating guides. Head to the official website here to apply.

June was another thrilling month for our creators. Players can check out all 12 of the guides that range from solo raids to individual character paths.

 

Tenebrous armor is an important part of gearing up your characters. NextActRena published a new guide that covers everything you need to know, from shadow effects to reforging and more. NextActRena continues to push out new content regularly to help players through their adventures. Be sure to check out their channel for more great content!



\[embed][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zzWwHcxUy0Q&feature=youtu.be"][/dynamiclink]\[/embed]



 

If you are in need of assistance with force skills, look no further than Fantasmo’s latest guide. Their new guide is part two of helping players understand everything from challenge mode forces to Legendary forces.



\[embed][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tgttbLAXB9A&ab_channel=Fantasmo"][/dynamiclink]\[/embed]



 

For more content, stay up to date with the content creator page. This page is updated weekly with all of the new content if you want to follow closely and see what else the creators have to offer. Here is a look at everything that was published in June.

 

Gameplay Guides

Tenebrous Armor Guide

Advanced Force Skills Guide

Fishing Guide

Pet Expedition & Potion Guide

Varnimyr Raid (Crimson Tower of Howling Flames) Solo Guide

Varnimyr Raid (Never-Ending Darkness) Solo Raid Guide

Varnimyr Raid (Crimson Tower of Howling Flames) Solo Guide

 

Character Guides

Picking a main in Elsword. Is Rena right for you?

Ara Apsara Guide

Ara Surya Guide

Rena Daybreaker Guide

Rena Twilight Guide

 

We look forward to sharing more content with you this upcoming month! Be sure to join the Elsword Discord to keep up to date with all things Elsword.

 	The difficulty/progression/reward will be categorized as follows.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4961457/39b527f32250a7d6af7d8687f4defc22b41bed31.jpg

 	The Receive button will be removed from the Rewards UI for the Varnimyr, Pruinaum, and Abyss Raid.

 	Following the removal of the Receive button, players will gain Weapon Drop Gauge and Purification Gauge upon obtaining the weekly reward for each phase’s boss.
 	Players can obtain the raid rewards (Mystic Stone/Imprint Stone Cube, Abyss Aura Purifier) within the dungeon upon clearing each phase.
 	Upon selecting Solo Mode, the ‘Queue for Dungeon (F8)’ button will be changed to ‘Enter Dungeon (F8)’.
 	The Solo Mode will share progression with Normal Mode.

 	For example, players can enter Phase 2 as Normal Mode after clearing Phase 1 as Solo Mode.

 	Players can also enter Phase 2 as Solo Mode after clearing Phase 1 as Normal Mode.
 	Entry to Phase 2 as Solo/Normal Mode is not available when Phase 1 is cleared as Story Mode.
 	The Solo Mode will share the Weekly Reward Count with Normal Mode.
 	 An exclusive buff will be applied upon entering as Solo Mode.

 	All Rounder: 1 of the following buffs will be applied upon entering a dungeon depending on the character’s class.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4961457/64bead09568ad3286ff506d75a644cb3d1e3f5ec.jpg
 	Unbreakable Will: Upon entering the dungeon, receive a buff that grows stronger over time.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4961457/7ca9e3577648637451dbdefc51b73fc98b44db52.jpg

★ Dismantling Amplified Circuit Improvements

 	A filter function dedicated for Amplified Circuits will be added to the Item Dismantle function.

 	Dismantle Circuits at the Set Stat or Below (Socket Stat)

 	Players can set a socket stat to filter out Amplified Circuits with the sockets below the set stat.

 	The stats for Party Buff effect sockets and All Elemental Resistance effect sockets will be marked separately as shown below.
 	Circuit Dismantle Detailed Settings (Socket Type)

 	Players can check all socket types that appear in Amplified Circuits.
 	Checked sockets are included in the filter. Players can select all socket types at once via the Dismantle All button.
 	Auto Dismantle Circuits Upon Identification

 	If ‘Auto Dismantle Circuits Upon Identification’ is checked in the Item Dismantle UI, all identified circuits will be dismantled when there is a circuit that matches the conditions.
 	The Amplified Circuit Filter settings will be saved account-wide.
 	The number of items that can be dismantled at once will be expanded from 30 to 100.

Example) A Tenebrous armor with 20% Guaranteed Success Gauge at +10 will become a Tenebrous armor with 60% Guaranteed Success Gauge at +10 after the improvements.

★ Mailbox UI Improvements

 	The Mailbox UI will be changed

 	When opening the Mailbox UI, the most recently received unopened mail category is selected.
 	System Mail: Menu for viewing System Mail

 	The System Mail is categorized into Account, Character, Bond, Guild.

 	Account: Players can view account-based mail, which can be viewed by all characters in the account.
 	Character: Players can view character-based mail.
 	Bond: Players can view reward mail related to Couple/Marriage and Partner/Soulmate.
 	Guild: Players can view reward mail related to the Guild.
 	The System Mail displays the Title, Attachment (Item Icon), and Deletion Date.
 	Up to 300 System Mail are displayed.

 	Players can view excess mail by clicking the Refresh button after deleting existing mail.
 	The Stewardship Coin reward mail will be sent to the Account Mail.
 	Normal Mail: Menu for viewing mail sent from other players

 	The Normal Mail displays the Title, Attachment, and Sender (Sender’s Nickname).
 	Up to 30 mail items are stored.
 	Send Mail: Menu for sending mail to other players

 	Players can view the Friend/Account List for the character by clicking the + button in the Recipient section. Players can click the Send to Guild Members checkbox to send a group mail to all guild members.

 	Items and ED cannot be attached to Guild Mail.
 	The title is automatically displayed as [‘Your Character’s Nickname’s Mail]. However, this can be edited.
 	Settings ( ): Menu for setting functions such as Mail Blocking

 	Fixed a bug where deleted characters remained in the Block List.
★ Doom Aporia Raid - Wilting Tower Dungeon Separation

 	The Wilting Tower Dungeon of the Doom Aporia Raid will be separated into ‘Wilting Tower: Flight’ (Phase 1 & 2) and ‘Wilting Tower: Fall’ (Phase 3).

 	The Dungeon Entry # of Players, Combat Power, Adaptation, and Equipment Requirements remain the same.
 	Players must clear ‘Wilting Tower: Flight’ to enter ‘Wilting Tower: Fall’.
 	All players in the party must clear the same stage of ‘Wilting Tower: Flight’ to enter ‘Wilting Tower: Fall’ together.
 	The entry stage of ‘Wilting Tower: Fall’ will be based on the cleared stage of ‘Wilting Tower: Flight’.
 	Players must clear ‘Wilting Tower: Fall’ after clearing ‘Wilting Tower: Flight’ to obtain Wilting Tower repeat rewards and Undead Dragon’s Heart Fragments.
 	Upon clearing ‘Wilting Tower: Fall’, players cannot re-renter ‘Wilting Tower: Fall’. Instead, players must clear ‘Wilting Tower: Flight’ again for re-entry.
 	The weapon advancement quest conditions for the Undead Dragon’s Will - Mortal Weapon will be changed.

 	The 'Accessory Gauge' can be obtained equally regardless of the difficulty (Stage 3/4).

 	Set effects must be in the [Activated Set Effects] list after being equipped to activate the effect.

★ Ice Burner Revamp
  As  previously announced in the January 22nd announcement, the following changes will be made to the Ice Burner  system.       We will be  overhauling the entire content set by increasing the drop rate for specific key  items, including the Ice Burner costumes and accessories. Additionally, we will  introduce a new system that allows players to spend Ice Burner Points to obtain  their desired Ice Burner costumes and accessories. The price of Ice Burners  will be adjusted from 100 K-Ching to 160 K-Ching.     Ice Burner Point System      An Ice Burner Point System will be  added that allows players to select an Ice Burner costume or accessory.     Ice Burner Points can be  obtained through using Ice Burners. The number of points obtained varies  depending on the rank of the item obtained.   
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4961457/1cd568702787cf00176fcb61ef39a33bd1caa357.jpg
      When players  reach 100% Ice Burner Points, they can choose 1 of the Ice Burner costumes or  accessories.    Ice Burner  Points obtained in each season are valid until the item’s sale end date. They  will be deleted once the sale ends.          Players can only use Ice Burner Points on  Ice Burner Costumes and Accessories for the corresponding season.      Ice Burner Points cannot be obtained when  using bonus Ice Burners earned through promotions such as 1+1 or  Fireworks Ice Burners.      After reaching 100% Ice Burner Points and  selecting a costume or accessory, the item will be sent to the [Ice Burner  Inventory].      Ice Burner Points are earned on a  per-account basis.        Ice Burner  Content Changes and Rate Adjustments      Certain Items from Ice Burner content will  be removed and added.  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4961457/e697646d9783aa9379ae3ab98aeea04a7fbbb813.jpg

      Ice Burner costumes and accessories chances will  be increased.    The existing crafting materials will be  removed, and crafting accessories will be added as part of the Ice Burner  contents accordingly.    Dedicated Ice  Burner Inventory Added      Items obtained from opening Ice Burners will  now be stored in a separate ‘Ice Burner Inventory’.    Ice Burner Inventory is available for shared  account use.    Players can only [Withdraw] from the Ice  Burner Inventory. Items cannot be returned to the inventory space once  withdrawn.  
★Mod Force Skill (Raven/Elesis/Ara/Lu/Ciel/Lithia)

Fixed a bug where the  ‘Continue Using’ button UI had unintended movement when used to open multiple  Sealed Relic Burners. ★ New Equipment – Exascale Armor
New Equipment: Exascale Armor

 	Exascale Armor refined from special metals found in the Land of Steel is updated.
 	Exascale Armor can be obtained directly from Epic Quests or crafted with Circuit Fragments through Camp: Steel Wall’s NPC Haivan.

 	 Circuit Fragments can be obtained by disassembling Amplified Circuits and System Chips
Exascale Armor Reforge
[Exascale Armor Reforge]

 	A system that allows players to make their Exascale Armor stronger. Each Reforge Stage increases the Exascale Armor's stats and adds Reforge effects.
 	Reforge can be done through each villages’ Blacksmiths.
 	Exascale Reforge can be attempted with one of the following materials: Refined Exikel or Zetrium Steel.
[table]
[tr]
[td]Material Name[/td]
[td]How to Obtain[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Refined Exikel[/td]
[td]Serpentium Dungeon/Serpentium Dungeon’s Daily Quest Reward[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Zetrium Steel[/td]
[td]Serpentium Dungeon[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Magical Crystal[/td]
[td]By playing dungeons/disassembling equipment[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
This system is identical to the existing reforge system, excluding Reforge Material and Option per Reforge Stage.
[Reforge Transfer System]

 	Reforge Transfer is a system that allows players to move Tenebrous Armor's Reforge Stage to Exascale Armor.
 	Tenebrous Armor must be Reforge Stage 18 or higher and can only be transferred to the armor with the same item part.
 	There are 2 types of Reforge Transfer, Normal Reforge Transfer and Special Reforge Transfer.
[table]
[tr]
[td]Reforge Transfer[/td]
[td]Features[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Normal Reforge
Transfer[/td]
[td]Use Refined Exikel, Zetrium Steel, Magical Crystal, and ED to transfer Reforge Stage.
The higher the Reforge Stage, the more it would cost.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Special Reforge
Transfer[/td]
[td]Use Reforge Stage Transfer Ticket, Magical Crystal, and ED to transfer Reforge Stage.
The higher the Reforge Stage, the more it would cost.
Reforge Stage Transfer Ticket can be purchased in the Item Mall.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
 	The number of materials needed for Reforge Transfer differs depending on the Reforge Stage players wish to transfer. The transfer done will be 6 stages lower than the starting Reforge Stage.

 	(EX. Tenebrous Armor +18 Reforge Stage will become Exascale Armor +12 Reforge Stage upon Reforge Transfer.)
System Chip Tuning

 	Players can earn unsealed System Chips by playing Raid Dungeons, which can then be used for [Chip Tuning] through Camp: Steel Wall’s NPC Haivan.
 	System chips that has completed tuning can be equipped to the new armor.

 	Only system chips with 0 remaining tuning counts can be equipped to Exascale.
 	Only unlocked System Chips can be attempted for Tuning, and can be equipped.
 	Equipped system chips can be overwritten by other system chips.
[Chip Tuning Details]

 	Upon pressing the Tuning button, it will either be success or fail based on chance.

 	ED is required for Tuning Attempts.
 	Tuning success rate is max. 70% and min. 30%.
[table]
[tr]
[td]Tuning Success[/td]
[td]Tuning Fail[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]- Increasing Stat
- Available Tuning Count Decrease 1 Time
- Next Tuning Success Chance Decrease 10%)[/td]
[td]- Decreasing Stat
- Available Tuning Count Decrease 1 Time
- Next Tuning Success Chance Increase (10%)[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
Amplified Circuit

 	‘Amplified Circuit’ can be purchased through the Shop or by playing dungeons, and can be equipped onto new armor through the Circuit Amplification UI.
 	Amplified Circuit has 4 different categories: color, shape, slot, and option.
Color

 	Connecting a Circuit with only one color activates the Set Color for that part, and activating all 4 parts of the armor with the same Set Color activates the Set Effect.
[table]

[/tr]
[tr]

Obtain 'Flow' Effect for 30 sec. if the armor's Skill

Change to 'Complete' Effect for 5 sec. if [Item Special

Change to 'Repair' Effect for 60 sec. once 'Complete'

 	Top Piece, Bottom Piece, Gloves, Shoes can only be equipped on each designated piece of equipment.
Option

 	If the start and end of the circuit are connected without a break, players can receive the Option Effect.
[Circuit Amplification Details]

 	Circuit Amplification can be done through [Equip Circuit] function from Camp: Steel Wall’s NPC Haivan.
Circuit Board

 	Players can equip Owned Circuits to the Circuit Board, and is divided into parts: Top Piece, Bottom Piece, Gloves and Shoes.
 	Hovering the mouse over the equipped circuit shows the information about that circuit.
Activated Effect

 	The combined stats of all circuits that are being applied is displayed.
Owned Circuit List

 	Players can view information about Circuit items owned in the inventory. At this point, only the circuit with the same equipment slot as the circuit that is being assembled is visible.
 	Right-click on the circuit item to be equipped in the Owned Circuit List, then click on the area to equip on the circuit board.
Revert/Apply

 	Revert/Apply button will be activated if there is a Circuit equipped to the Circuit Board.

★ Pet Extraction System

 	Pet Extraction Item product will be added, as announced in the last summer’s update.
 	The Pet Extraction Item allows players to extract a pet that is bound to a character into a tradeable item. The extracted item stores the pet growth points, available growth points, and whether it has a Fetch Aura. (Temporary Pet Fetch Aura will be deleted upon extraction.)
 	Please see the announcement below for other Pet Extraction conditions and details.
 	Pet Extraction Ticket

 	Pet Extraction Tickets will go on sale upon the addition of the Pet Extraction function.How to Extract Pets

 	While holding the Pet Extraction Ticket, click “Extract” in the Summons: Pet UI to proceed with the extraction -> Receive as a tradeable item in your inventory.

 	(Extraction will not be available for Temporary Pet, Pets that are not in their Adult Stage, Pets placed in El House/on Expedition, VIP Premium Pet, Pets with Items in their Pet Inventory, and Pets with “Potion of Youth” applied.)Pet Info Retained when Extracting PetsPet Growth Point (Growth Points invested in Cheer/Patience/Mastery/Focus), Available Growth Points, Fetch Aura Activation (Temporary Pet Fetch Aura will be deleted upon extraction.)Pet Info Reset when Extracting PetsPet Name, Pet Hunger, Pet Affinity, Pet Accessory (Gem of Skill), Time needed for Digestion

★ Character

 	[Common]

 	Improved bottom piece and foot sizing when Elsword ~ Chung characters wear Andre Banthus, Shark Hunter, Street Star Bottom Piece, and Shoes.
 	Fixed a bug where using a skill that consumes a special resource and being hit at the same time would cause a special resource to be consumed even though the skill was not activated in certain circumstances.
 	Improved action process for skills that do not use motion.

 	For skills that do not use motion, like Elsword’s Iron Body or Aisha’s Body-type skills, have been improved from using a skill and being hit at the same time causing MP to be consumed and cooldown applied but effect not applied, to MP consumption and cooldown applied only after the effect is applied.
 	[Aisha]

 	Fixed a bug where the thigh appearance looked awkward when Street Star Shoes is equipped.
 	[Lord Azoth]

 	Fixed a bug where Quick Slot Cooldown Change buffs received from party members would be labeled as Character 1 during the Stone of Wisdom passive effect.
 	[Rena]

 	Fixed a bug where the Nature Aura buff icon can be seen in Village.
 	[Ara]

 	Fixed a bug where the skin color looked awkward when Archdevil Set Costume is equipped.
 	[Apsara]

 	Fixed a bug where players would not restore energy correctly when killing monsters in Eun Mode.
 	[Elesis]

 	[Bloody Queen]

 	Fixed a bug where MP recovery was incorrectly applied when hitting an enemy with the [Mod] Brandish Breaker skill.
 	[Add]

 	Fixed a bug where players would not be able to awaken even though DP was consumed when awakening while being hit.
 	Fixed a bug where Add would not awaken but have DP consumed if the awakening key was pressed right before advancing to the next dungeon stage under certain circumstances.
 	[Arc Tracer]

 	Fixed a bug where the Panzer Buster skill effect looked abnormal when used where the platform bends.
 	[Mad Paradox]

 	Fixed a bug where the Dynamo Mutation Point consumption effect would not apply when using the [Mod] Moonlight Breaker skill in certain circumstances.

Fixed a bug in Tricky House boss stage where Mister Hat’s Picture Frame Magic mechanic also dealt damage to party members in the same area.Fixed a bug in Blooming Mineral Field where the skill icon would disappear when the Sea Current Adaptation buff expired and the stack count reduced.Fixed a bug in The Great Steel Wall stage 2 where dismounting the turret did not work as intended in certain situations.Fixed a bug in Challenge Mode – Annihilator where the boss could not be hit in certain situations.
★ Item
El Resonance Potion acquired from trading with NPC Fishing Site Helen will be changed to a stackable version of the El Resonance Potion.Current El Resonance Potion will remain as is.Fixed a bug where characters would be displaced if they used certain custom motions in town.
★ ETC
Added a pop-up window to display seal count remaining when extracting force skills.Fixed a bug where players could start certain dungeons even if they did not meet the entry requirements.Fixed a bug where other players could not see buff icons already applied to players who just got invited to the party.Applied PVP Stat Adjustments to Detailed Stats UI (Match) and Free Training (PVP Stat).

★Secret Dungeon Reward ED Adjustment  Pre-Announcement 

From the overall ED Gain data  collected from last year 2023-12-06 Secret Dungeon Revamp  update to now, we believe that the polarization of obtainable ED has been  partly resolved.

However, we have noticed the ED Gain  from Secret Dungeons have increased 4 times since the Secret Dungeon update,  and the overall ED Gain up to 2 times. This numbers have far over-exceeded our  expectations, and brings concern that it may be a major factor in ED value  dropping in the long run. To prevent this outcome, we will be adjusting some of  Secret Dungeon ED Gain.

When looking at the ED Gain per CP stage in the Secret dungeon, the farming  based on CP has been functioning mostly as intended. We intend to adjust the ED  gain only in stage 3 and stage 4, as the amount of ED gained from stage 1 and  stage 2 have not been extensive, and we acknowledge the importance of  early-game ED acquisition. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4961457/a5e2c80ff5a879153b370a8468dc457a6eddb102.png

We understand that the issue of adjusting the amount of ED gain is a sensitive  matter and approach it as such, especially because ED acquisition is directly  connected to the game’s economy.

However, even with all  this consideration, we believe the current ED gain in Secret Dungeon will have  a major impact in future ED value and the overall game economy; therefore, it  is imperative to make adjustments now.
  
The above adjustments  will be applied with the 4-24 maintenance. We will continue to check on the issue of ED Gain  and make sure that all Elsword adventurers can enjoy a stable game environment.

★ Awakening System Revamp
All characters awakening system will be revamped on the 1/31 game maintenance update. 	All characters except add will be able to re-awaken. 	You can charge up to 3 Awakening Beads. 	You cannot charge any more awakening gauge once you charge 3 awakening beads. 	The awakening state is not related to the awakening gauge charge. 	You can use awakening up to 3 stages. 	The buff icon changes depending on the awakening stage. 	3 stage awakening characters excluding Ain will show the awakening stack up to 3 stages. 	Stage 1 awakening characters will not show stack event when re-awakening. 	Use all charged awakening beads upon awakening. 	All awakening beads will be used upon re-awakening as well. 	Upon re-awakening, if the current awakening stage is lower than 3, the awakening stage will change depending on the number of awakening beads used. 	Ex. If you are in stage 1 awakening and have 1 awakening bead, you become stage 2 awakening upon re-awakening. 	If you are in stage 1 awakening and have 2 awakening beads, you become stage 3 awakening upon re-awakening. 	If you re-awaken when in stage 3 awakening state, stage 3 related effects related to skill or unique system will activate upon re-awakening. 	Excluding Add, all character’s basic awakening duration will increase to 90 seconds. 	Basic awakening duration will be max 90 seconds, but it can exceed 90 seconds through effects such as skills or stats. 	Upon force awakening, it will apply as if you used 1 awakening bead. 	Ex. ★ Secret Dungeon Revamp
  With the Secret Dungeon Revamp, Secret Dungeons will now become solo dungeons that can be entered when the character level is Lv.99 or higher.  The number of stages decreased compared to before. The stages are separated by Combat Power, so try out the Secret Dungeon that matches your character's combat power.
Secret  Dungeon Info

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4961457/b64c9d693797ecf0d36d766073decfb46ad8b8c9.jpg

  Entering Secret Dungeon will no longer use an Entry  Ticket. Each account will have 5 free entrances per week.  Weekly available entrances will decrease after clearing the dungeon.  Luto Mode will be removed after the revamp.  The Secret Dungeon will not be affected by EXP, Drop  Rate socket effect and Event related effects, and will only be affected by  'Secret Dungeon' only effects.  With the Update, Secret Dungeon Entry Permit and Secret  Dungeon Cube (Weapon, Armor, Accessory) can no longer be obtained.  Random Mission will not appear in Secret Dungeons.  You can exchange 'Secret Dungeon Entry Permit' obtained  through dungeon drops with other items through NPC Ariel.

Secret  Dungeon Reward

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4961457/c7311720c7bf8aedaca5ce40af73ae49b4519036.jpg

★ Dormant Nickname Reset
 	As previously announced, character nicknames of accounts that haven’t logged on since 2020-09-01 00:00 PT  will have their nicknames reset upon 2023-08-30 MA. The reset nicknames will not be immediately available after 8/30 maintenance, instead can be used through character creation or nickname change after 09/01 7 PM PDT.
★ New Region & Dungeon Update – Monaterra
 	New Region Monaterra is added and New Dungeons ‘Palace of Gold Medovine’, ‘Hunter’s Hideout’, and ‘Torta Arena’ are updated. 	You must clear To a New Region > ‘Entering Monaterra’ Epic Quest to access Monaterra region. 	New Dungeon: Palace of Gold Medovine / Hunter’s Hideout / Torta Arena 	The last chapter of Red Demon Territory, Monaterra region and dungeons are updated. 	You can enter Monaterra region dungeons after clearing ‘Entering Monaterra’ quest.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4961457/852aefb577d1b49a84d75fa53a689906c5f10f6d.jpg
 	You need an entrance ticket (Torta Clan’s Invitation) to enter ‘Torta Arena’. 	Torta Clan’s Invitation can be obtained as daily special rewards when playing Monaterra region dungeon.★ Modification System Added
 	New Item: Harconium Tuning Reactor 	The item based on Monaterra machinery, Harconium Tuning Reactor, is updated. 	Harconium Tuning Reactor item is used to modify armor. You can obtain them directly as a drop from Monaterra dungeons or can be crafted through Magmelia NPC Vasili by collecting Harconium Steel. 	Harconium Steel can be obtained by dismantling Harconium Tuning Reactor items. 	Harconium Tuning Reactor items can be obtained from ‘Palace of Gold Medovine’, ‘Hunter’s Hideout’, and ‘Torta Arena’ dungeons. 	Armor Modification 	Armor Modification system allows you to make Tenebrous armor even stronger by imbuing modification effects to Tenebrous Armor through Harconium Tuning Reactor’s additional effects. 	Modification effect is activated when equipping 4 kinds of Tenebrous Armor with modification effect open. 	Even if they are not identical effects, as long as 4 Tenebrous Armor with modification effect open are equipped, modification effect will be activated.
★ Other QoL Improvements
 	Characters participating in Guild Expedition can also be kicked or leave from the guild. 	If there are guild expedition rewards that haven’t been received when kicked or leaving the guild, the unreceived rewards will be immediately sent to the mailbox. 	Adaptation Elixir buff durations have been increased to 30 min. 	Dungeon/Field Big Head debuff effect and Dwarf’s Potion is removed. 	Demon Realm Energy or Consumable items crafted using Demon Realm Energy have been changed as ‘tradeable’. 	Certain requirements for Random Mission has been removed or improved. Information on certain items’ effects and effect duration has been added to certain item descriptions to make the effects of certain consumable/elixir items clearer.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4961457/cbb9fbd5259e83b9ecda1a3e932ca89dd849f539.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4961457/d9a10126432aa541b84e05087329f4c07c95f6da.jpg

 	Inventory and Pet Inventory UI is changed to match the new UI design. 	Size can be adjusted by clicking and dragging the lower right corner of the new UI. 	Clicking on the mouse wheel when on the UI will reset the location and size of the UI. 	Clicking on the hourglass icon at the bottom of the Inventory UI will allow you to check temporary items within the inventory. 	Sort locking feature that locks certain items in the desired slots unaffected by inventory sort function is added. 	An inventory item search function is added. 	When searching for items, a list will be shown. Click on the list to move to the inventory page where the item is stored. The item slot of the clicked item will be accepted. 	Equipped items (Fishing, Artifact included), and items in Shared Bank/Pet Inventory cannot be searched. 	Max number of pages that can be expanded for Equipment ~ Costume Inventory has increased. (Excluding El House) 	Stack Items (Glaciem Ore, Tasma Aura Mass etc) have changed to allow opening multiple at once. 	Stack Select Cube (Antique Seed Select Pouch, Mystical Elixir Box etc) has changed to allow opening multiple at once. notes.title: Create Partnerships or Become Soulmates with this NEW UPDATE!
notes.notes:
https://i.imgur.com/uvY49Bf.jpg

Heya adventurers! We've got a big fun update for Elsword's bond system! With the Partner & Soulmate System, you can either choose to be in a partnership with someone or become each other's soulmate! Each will have their own benefits so better prep yourself to ask that special someone and get all fun benefits and rewards! And don't forget to check out the fun new things we have at the Item Mall!



Love Vs Friendship Select Event

It's time to build that relationship with the other El Gang member! For this event, you can choose to build your relationship with one character, but building relationships with more characters will reap more rewards!


 Increase your Affinity Stage with your selected character by 1 when you Login for 5 accumulative minutes AND clear dungeons within your level range twice!
 You can get another increase in Affinity Stage by 1 when you use your selected character to clear dungeons within your level range twice!
 Keep increasing character Affinity Stage and you'll get enough [Cobo] Mark of Love or [Cobo] Mark of Friendship which you can exchange to Ariel for consumables, costumes, custom motions, and more!



Item Mall Goodies

Present yourself in a stunning, head-turning manner! Mesmerize your enemies and dazzle them not only with skills but with your looks! Get your hands on Ambience Paramatric this week!

Spend time alone or with your soulmate in this relaxing Memory of a Soulmate Custom Motion! You'll definitely be making wonderful memories here!

https://i.imgur.com/y343it0.jpg


That's all for now folks~

See y'all in-game!

[Announcements]

★ Pruinaum Raid Challenge Mode

Pruinaum Raid Challenge Mode can be  challenged as a Striker Party and is separated to dungeons that separate the 8  players into 2 parties and dungeons that have all 8 players enter together.
  
Dungeon  Entry Requirements

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4961457/22ea608071254a59a40314aaf1c1452743616d38.jpg


Enter  Challenge Mode
  Each dungeon for Pruinaum Raid  Challenge Mode has a time limit and the countdown will start the moment on  clicking the ‘Challenge Start’ button.  Clear records are reset every  week on Wednesday, and the Challenge Mode you can enter will change.
    After the 4/12 update until 4/19, players  can enter Pruinaum Raid Challenge Mode, and cannot enter Varnimyr Challenge  Mode.
Challenge  Mode Battle Start
  For dungeons for 3~4 players, the  battle will start when all party members are in the waiting room,  For dungeons for 4~8 players, all players  will enter together and fight in the same space.  Other characters that started  the challenge together that’s not in the striker party cannot be invited to the  striker party during the challenge. But when a party member somehow exits from  the party, then that party member can be invited again provided that every  striker party member is not playing the dungeon.  Party Buff/Heal/Item/Special  effects will only apply to your current party and the debuff applied to the  boss will be shared to all striker party members.  When the time limit ends, the  dungeon will automatically be forfeited and will start from the first boss of  each dungeon when challenging again. (You will be exited from the dungeon if  it’s during the dungeon.)  The party leader can forfeit  the challenge when there’s time remaining and when every party member agrees  through the pop-up window, they can forfeit the challenge.
Raid  and Raid Challenge Mode System Changes
  Raid and Raid Challenge Mode  Reset time is changed from Every Tuesday 23:00 ~ Wednesday 00:10 to Every  Tuesday 23:50 ~ Wednesday 00:10. Playtime will end at Tuesday 23:50.  Raid Ranking will be removed  from the ranking boards available at boards and Camp NPCs. Raid Ranking Rewards  for after the 04/05 Raid Clearance Update will not be distributed.
Reward  Item
  You can obtain ‘Annihilating Soul Aura’ as a reward  every week 1 time by clearing the last stage per dungeon. This item can be  exchanged with Pet: Annihilator Automata, Pruinaum Region Accessory Select Cube  and other various items through Camp: Aurora NPC, Asella.  Players may obtain the following  force skills as drops when clearing Altar of Invocation: Annihilator dungeon.

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4961457/064802ecdd21cc7311a36cedcad8228ff28a7bb7.jpg

★ Elrios Pass Season 4

Clear missions every day and receive various rewards  with the Elrios Pass Season 4 update!
  Season Pass will go on  for 12 weeks. Once the season ends, you will no longer be able to receive the  rewards.
  * Elrios Pass Season 4 will be from 2023/4/12  00:00 ~ 2023/7/4 23:59.

How  to Use Elrios Pass 
  Click on the Elrios Pass UI at  the top of the screen to enter.   Clear Daily/Weekly/Season missions to gain  Season Pass EXP. Achieve specific levels to obtain Normal (Free)/Premium  reward.Elrios  Pass Item Mall Item

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4961457/c4216ec1bef2fc1d05999a4f74135326f504d555.jpg

 How to use Tenebrous Effect Select  Ticket 
  * Here are instructions on how to  use the Elrios Pass Season 4 reward, Tenebrous Effect Select Ticket.
  * What are Tenebrous Effect Select  Tickets? Tenebrous Effect Select Tickets allow you to imbue the max stat  of the desired Shadow Effect to your Tenebrous Equipment.

[olist]  Right-click on the Tenebrous  Equipment you want to imbue effects from the inventory.

notes.title: Might and Magic Collides with Aisha and Chung’s Master Class Release!
notes.notes:
https://i.imgur.com/kikK0wt.jpg

Heya adventurers! If you’re fans of our OG Mage and OG Berserker, then this is the week you’ve all been waiting for! Chung and Aisha reach the pinnacle of power with Master Class and we want you to experience it!

If Aisha and Chung aren’t your characters, then why not make one? The second Character Creation Event will provide your new characters with items for a quick leveling up experience without the grind, so what are you waiting for? Time for some action!

And as always, don’t forget that we always have fun and exciting things at the Item Mall for y’all!

Denif Master Dungeon Events

You’ll be drowning in rewards when Denif’s done with you or – is it the other way around? No matter, win or lose rewards abound!

 You don’t even have to fight him! Just login for a good 20 minutes and you’ll get the Water Dragon Scale (14 Days) Title and Water Aura Arm Ornament!

notes.title: Upcoming Quality of Life Changes (July 11th Update)
notes.notes:
MORE CONVENIENT

[Free Skill Slot Medal/Quick Slot]
All characters’ b slot and quick slot expansion will be free.
* Transcendence Skill Slot will not be expanded for free but you can acquire it by clearing a quest or purchasing it from the ED Shop in the Item Mall.

[ED Shop Update]
ED Shop contains Skill Slot Medal (Transcendence), Adult Pet, Fetch Aura, Costumes per Character, and etc. will be sold.
* Items purchased from the ED Shop can be stored in the share bank but cannot be traded.

[NPC Reward Exchange Function Change]
When exchanging multiple Random items from an NPC, you can receive different items.


FASTER

[Beginning Section Improved]
Noah’s Lake field will disappear and Elder Town and Ruben Town will be directly connected via porta.
Quests related to Fields will either disappear or have their quest rewards and exp will be changed.
Elrios Guide will be changed to Contents Guide and can be searched by key words.
Required Level for Ereda Island and Quests will be changed to Lv.90.
Quests related to Luto Mode will require Lv.75.

[Skip Function Improved]
When a Lv.5 or higher character uses the Quest Skip function, they will receive 50% of the EXP and receive the reward item.
(However, ED will not be rewarded and some quests related to Secret/Heroic Dungeons will not be skippable.)
Recommended level for dungeons will be displayed on the dungeon select screen.

[Elrios Studio Quest Removed]
All quests related to Elrios Studio will be removed. (Players with already accepted quests can still complete it.)
Quests rewards like ‘High-Performance Nasod Megaphone’ and ‘Cobo Entertainment Studio’ can be purchased from the Item Mall using K-Ching or ED.
However, items purchased from the ED Shop will be tagged [Cobo] and cannot be traded.

[Mentor Quest Improved]
Mentor Quest requirement will be improved.

[El Resonance Quest Improved]
El Resonance Quests will be improved.

[Camilla’s Skill Quest Improved]
Camilla’s Intermediate/Advanced/Expert Manual quests will be improved.

[Stamina Improved!]
Stamina spent from all dungeons and fields will be reduced and Ereda Island no longer consumes stamina. 

[Old Character Inventory Expansion] 
All old characters with Inventories smaller than 8 x 5 will be expanded to 8 x 5. 

[Market Board ED Limit Increase] 
Market Board ED Limit will increase from 3 Billion ED to 5 Billion ED. 

[Share Bank Improvement] 
You can now deposit ED in share bank. (Limit 5 Billion ED depending on the player’s Bank Rank) 
Share Bank now has a sort function.

[Secret/Heroic Dungeon, Elrianode City, and El Tower Defense can be entered 1 time a day for free] 
Free Daily Entry will reset every midnight server time. 

[Secret Dungeon Tab] 
All Secret Dungeons will be moved to a Secret Dungeon tab. The Secret Dungeon tab will be opened at Lv.70. 

[Heroic Gear Improved] 
All Heroic Gears can no longer go below Heroic Rank Lv.10. 


MORE IMPROVEMENTS!
[Equipment Enhancement Safe to +8!)]
Equipment Enhance can no longer fail up to +8.
[Apocalypse Type – Void Weapon Cube can now be share banked.]
[As you clear Add’s Energy Fusion Theory Dungeon without getting the Weapon Drop, the chances of the weapon cube dropping will increase.] 
Even if you don’t pick-up the weapon cube, once it drops, the increased drop rate will reset.

[Epic PVP Quest Improved]
Required level for quest will become Lv.75 and the quest will become easier. 
When clearing an Epic PVP Quest, you will be given Camilla’s Sparring Equipment Cube (+8) as a reward.

[Character Slot Revamp] 
Avg. Item Level will be removed from the Character Info UI but will be replaced by Combat/Defense Power. 
Also, dungeon entry requirements will be changed from Item Level to Combat Power. 
You can now check the below options from the Stats window.
Some stats will be shown as % instead of numbers. 
(Example: Maximize 572 à Maximize 4%)

[Item Revamp]
Equipment set effect from beginning leveling part will be removed. (lv.1 ~ Lv.90, Secret Dungeon Excluded), Magic Stone Enchant Socket numbers will increase depending on the level. 
Depending on the Rank of Lv.1 ~ Lv.90, Secret Dungeon Excluded, will be provided more random effects.
Specialization A & B will be removed and the A & B options will be changed.

[If Specialization A & B is a fixed effect]
Critical Chance, Maximize % 
Certain Set Effects or Title Effects will be changed.

[If Specialization A & B is a random option or a socket effect]
You can change to the below effect from Ariel. 
* Critical Chance, Add Damage, Maximize, Add Damage, Attack Speed, Damage Reduction, MP Gain (Attack), MP Gain (Attacked)
Specific Skill Damage Increase effect will no longer appear from equipment. 
However, effects that existed before this change will remain and all new equipment will have ‘All Skill Damage Increase’ option.

[Old Ice Burner Improvement]
Old Ice Burners will no longer require phoru footstamps to trade. You can now freely trade all Ice Burners without seals.

For more details on all the changes happening with the 7/11 update, please visit our website here.

notes.notes:
https://i.imgur.com/i6tdO2w.jpg

KOG Games Begins the First of Three Large Updates

The highly anticipated 3rd Job First Path Update is here! This is the first of 3 updates that will feature 37 new Job classes in total; each update will usher in a new Job for every character for each Line.

In addition, the following features are debuting today:

One new dungeon: Forgotten Elrian Sanctum
First and second Job Advance items are free
Visual Update – Every Character (except Rose and Ain) have had their feet and hands resized for aesthetic improvement
In-game Prizes, Playtime Sweepstakes, Snowball Games, 2X’s EXP in PvP Arena and More!

To learn more about Elsword please visit www.elsword.com and keep watching the official Facebook page here. 

Play Your Manga!

notes.title: We’re Preparing You for Our Biggest and Best Update Yet! 3rd Jobs Are Coming Very Soon!
notes.notes:
https://i.imgur.com/KXaGd9Q.jpg

Heya adventurers! We’re feeling immense powers looming over the not-so-distant lands and soon it will be yours! You just have to be patient, because great things are worth the wait, after all. However, since we’re so hyped up about it, here’s an overview of what will happen: Your characters will get the most awesome transformation you can imagine complete with the best skills you have ever laid eyes upon! For that to happen, we have to get you all prepped up that’s there will be tons of events and loads of rewards to boost you to 99 in no time! On top of that, we’re bringing you another much the anticipated update of trade improvements and ED limits! You can finally become the savvy business person you’ve always wanted to be in Elrios! And as always, the Item Mall has some wonderful new stuff for you to check out! Don’t miss these updates and more tomorrow!

3rd Job Pre-Event
Now’s your chance to level up like a madman! We’ve got special events and boosts to make sure you reach level 99 before 3rd jobs roll in!
First up, your selected character to participate in the event automatically gets half of the EXP required to level up at no cost! All you have to do is half the job of leveling that character up! 
Characters who achieve Transcendence during the event will get Book of Transcendence to bypass quests and requirements! So convenient!
When you reach level 90, you’ll get a Unique-Grade Heroic Weapon to deal an even mightier blow! Who can resist rewards?! No one!
And there’s so much more that you’ll definitely need to check out the site tomorrow for all the nitty-gritties!

Item Mall Goodies
It’s the most wonderful time for Ain! He’s getting two more epic Ice Burner sets to add to his wardrobe with the scholarly Miracle Alchemist Ice Burner Set and the firey Ignition Caligo Set. Collect them all tomorrow!

https://i.imgur.com/UZz5jRC.jpg

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: New Character Update: Ain
notes.notes:
KOG Games today announces the launch of Elsword’s newest character, Ain.

For the first time in KOG history, a character is being launched within a week of his launch on the home server in Korea.
Basically, Ain is completely unknown and he’s shaking things up around the world!

Eons back, Ain was sent by the Goddess to descend upon Elrios and the Tree of El. War between the denizens of Elrios was in full swing; prompting the great explosion. This explosion tore through the veil of existence in its entirety, sending Ain reeling through time. Present Day: Standing before the El Search party, Ain introduces himself as a priest serving the Goddess, an angelic figure of uncertain power and an unknown motive. The strikingly attractive and enigmatic character with a purpose and presence that transcends time.

Ain is an unorthodox caster class. Once in-game, it’s apparent that he practices magic on a different level that Elsword players have ever experienced before. His weapon is a pendulum, and he enters the fray by summoning and projecting ethereal weapons from the God's Realm.
He doesn’t need to keep enemies at bay with his magic. Instead, Ain keeps his opponents right where he wants them, and that’s wherever he decides they need to be. Ain is all about controlling his opponent’s position by restricting their options.

Ain has an all new, special system which allows him to change his attack method with two completely different modes:

-          Cycle Mode allows Ain to access to his skills faster by lowering the cooldown and MP cost of all his skills. Additionally, it also endows Ain with the ability to repeatedly dash through the air, at lightning speed, and break out of enemy combos at half the cost.

-          Creation Mode enhances all of Ain’s combos and commands. This gives him the ability to deal immense damage by infusing his attacks with heavenly firepower.

To summarize, Cycle Mode is all about utility while Creation Mode is all about dishing out damage.

As well, Ain will be receiving his first Job Line; a first for an Elsword character launch. Players will not only be able to enjoy a new character, they get to fully experience and play through one of 3 paths to Ain’s end game.
 
A heavenly amount a great events and prizes will be hosted in-game and on Elsword’s official FB page and Forums. As well, the amazingly talented composer Maks_SF is lending his gift of music to Elsword as he brings the angelic Ain to life in this new video – Watch: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=so72Wa8yh8k

Come play Ain. Play Elsword. Play your Manga.

notes.title: We’re All About Breaking Limits and Smashing Power Ceilings in Next Week’s Update!
notes.notes:
http://i.imgur.com/yLnptKx.jpg

Hiya adventurers! We’ve got another major update coming very soon, not tomorrow, but very soon (next week) and we’re thinking of pushing your heroes to their limits with this one. It’s not that hard. Seriously. Maybe? Oh don’t worry, we know you can overcome it and become the very best that no one ever was! The teaser event tomorrow will give you a sneak peek of sorts and we’re sure it’s going to be super easy for you guys. We also have a new field opening in Elysion called Judge’s Sanctuary so get ready to explore and fight harder enemies. We believe in your abilities, adventurers! And lastly, don’t forget to check out our amazing selection at the Item Mall because we know y’all want to ~

Special Game Update’s Teaser Event
We’ve got a few stuff going on as preparation for that special game update that’s guaranteed to push the limits of your heroes’ powers.
•	When you complete the condition of one quest to get a ticket, you can use that ticket to exchange for cool character summons with cool skeelz!
•	If you like puzzle pieces, then we have something similar when you collect the special game update’s fragments and then craft through Ariel to get a cool box with cool stuff inside!
•	You’ll also notice two new skill slots. Why? For the Special Game Update, of course! But you can’t use them yet. The anticipation is slow murder isn’t it?

Elrios Schoolwear Event
 Do you like school uniforms? If so, we’ve got an event just for you! You’ll get an abundance of school uniform pieces to mix and match, plus there’s a chance to turn them into permanent pieces!
•	Easily get Attendance Cubes which yields either one or more Elrios School Uniform Collection Cubes, Schoolwear Combiners and a Summon Stone: Maru (15 Days) when you log-in for 10 mins for the week’s attendance check!

notes.title: Eve and Aisha: Core Release and Memorize Systems
notes.notes:
This week’s update comes with 2 new exciting systems for Eve and Aisha. All of the characters of Elsword Online have unique systems for attacks and skills, some of which are activated in Awakening Mode. Now finally Eve and Aisha can benefit from these systems as well!

http://i.imgur.com/TxpZOE7l.jpg

Eve’s Core Release

The Queen of Nasods powers up with Core Release. Eve’s Core is activated in Awakening Mode. (The more beads the higher the level of the core). This will be indicated by the color change from blue to red. The Core can be charged up by performing hits and combos for more powerful attacks.

http://i.imgur.com/ekC6ITcl.jpg

The core defends Eve with Core’s Shield when enemies attempt to hit her while inactive. This decreases damage by 75%. When the shield is up, hitting X or Z will cause her to teleport backwards.

The core also attacks with Core’s Laser. This activates with certain actives/special active skills (but only is released if you hit your opponent. The Core’s Laser is strongest when in Awakened Level 3, dealing splash damage on mobs.

Lastly when the core is deactivated the remaining power will be spent towards HP/MP recovery. Pretty cool huh?

http://i.imgur.com/YWJTiOBl.jpg

Aisha’s Memorize System

Put those memorization skills to the test. Our adorable little magician’s new system enables her to memorize most of her Actives and Special Actives. Hit the skill you wish to memorize with a maximum of 3.  The default key to use the skill is V.

http://i.imgur.com/e1AElARl.jpg

Saving skills sort of acts like insurance and you can even use the same skill twice in a row (one from memorize and one from the original cooldown). Skills however in Memorize only deal 70% of the total damage. Also since setting the skills already consumes MP, the skills deployed using the memorized slot will not consume the original skill MP cost. 

ItemMall Goodies

Elesis gets her newest Ice Burner Set with the Royal Maid! <3

http://i.imgur.com/JNeh5Rfl.jpg

notes.title: Massive Skill Tree System Update Incoming!
notes.notes:
We’ve got a great game update coming in tomorrow for you to explore and enjoy. Here’s the lowdown on this extensive skill tree system update!

Brand-new Skills for All Characters
You will have the chance to learn additional skills with awesome effects and graphics. I can only show you some of them right now, but there will be multiple new skills per character, so play hard to learn all of them soon! See this one of Elsword’s:
http://i.imgur.com/gWoCq8dl.jpg

Here’s one of Rena’s:
 http://i.imgur.com/AKAEQfAl.jpg

And a spectacular one of Aisha’s:
http://i.imgur.com/dkw72Fml.jpg
 

Renewed Skill Tree and Points Structure
Experience the new skill tree, where you are required to make the choice between skills, but also where you can improve each skill up to Lv. 20! In order for you to do so, each time you level up you will earn 4 skill points, and more as you go higher. It’s intense!

More Stuff!!
You can also expect improvements on sealed skills, skill rings, and skill notes, as well as a selective character rebalance. See, it’s a pretty big deal of an update, so to help you make the most of it, there will also be events rewarding free skill reset items and an Elsword Online first—an all-in-one costume! See this version for Raven? Ooh, I can’t wait!

http://i.imgur.com/5UBO996l.png
 
Turn Friends into Elpeeps
We’re also holding an exciting referral program for two weeks! If you created your account today or earlier, you can become an El Recruiter starting tomorrow by inviting a friend who has never played Elsword Online. The two of you can both earn a heap of in-game stuff! So gather your non-playing pals and help them thrive in Elsword Online for maximum returns! Check www.elswordonline.com for the mechanics and reward details after the scheduled maintenance.

Bad Boys and Bad Girls
Misbehaving and looking good go together like a black leather jacket and spiky hair… or Eve and her drones in this brand new costume from the Item Mall:
http://i.imgur.com/xODrub2l.png

Get ready for these and more this November 6th!
